meta.note: Measurements from stainless/model.js; pass/fail is recomputed in the browser from the rulebook.

rulebook.about: Draft rulebook for stainless steel bottles and tumblers, single wall and double-wall vacuum, built from the research CSV (bottle_design_parameters.csv). Most forming limits are estimates; each rule says how sure it is. S = sourced, E = estimate, S/E = a sourced point with an estimated range.

brim_over_nominal.note: Brim-full volume is 5-10% over the label capacity; 7% typical.

spin_step.note: Diameter reduction per spin-necking pass, 10-20%; 15% typical.

thinning_exponent.note: Finished wall = starting wall x (1 + expansion)^-0.71, which reproduces US6182487: 0.4 mm bulged 40 to 60 mm thins to 0.3 mm.

draw_hd_per_stage.note: Each redraw adds about 0.5-1.0 of height/diameter; the first draw reaches about 0.6.

lid_g_narrow.note: Lid mass assumed for a narrow mouth; ours.

lid_g_wide.note: Lid mass assumed for a wide mouth; ours.

heat_lid_w_per_k_cm2.note: Heat leak through the lid per cm2 of mouth. Fitted, with the wall term, to Tiger MMZ 350/500/600 ml (69/74/76 C after 6 h, 44 mm mouth). Uncalibrated for other lids.

heat_wall_w_per_k_ml.note: Heat leak through the vacuum walls per ml of capacity; fitted as above.

cup_holder_depth_mm.note: Height of the band checked for car cup-holder fit.

lid_h_narrow_mm.note: Cap height added to a narrow-mouth bottle when comparing with listed heights, which include the cap; ours.

lid_h_wide_mm.note: Cap height for a wide mouth; ours.

lid_h_tumbler_mm.note: Press-fit lid height above a tumbler rim; ours.

rules.name: Bulge expansion
rules.plain: The widest part is {v} wider than the narrowest, more than one hydro-bulge stage gives
rules.note: One stage: +50% sourced (40 to 60 mm); 25-35% with pressure alone, 50-70% with axial feed (estimate). Two stages with an anneal reach 80-100%.

rules.name: Finished wall after forming
rules.plain: The outer wall thins to {v} where it is bulged most, under the 0.25 mm floor
rules.note: Denting, buckling under vacuum and weld burn-through set a 0.25-0.3 mm floor for bulged or drawn shells.

rules.name: Spin-necking passes
rules.plain: Necking down to this mouth takes {v}; 6 is the most
rules.note: Passes = ln(neck/shoulder) / ln(1 - 15%). Below a 0.5 ratio an anneal is likely.

rules.name: Draw stages
rules.plain: A seamless drawn body this tall needs {v}; 5 is the most
rules.note: First draw 40-50% reduction (sourced); each redraw adds about 0.5-1.0 of H/D (estimate).

rules.name: Vacuum gap
rules.plain: A {v} vacuum gap is outside 1.5-5 mm
rules.note: 2-3 mm standard, 4-5 mm premium (sourced); the 1.5 mm floor (dent bridging, tolerance) is an estimate.

rules.name: Outer wall at least the inner
rules.plain: The outer wall is thinner than the inner; the outer one carries the vacuum load
rules.note: The outer shell resists 0.1 MPa external pressure, so outer >= inner, typically by 0.1 mm.

rules.name: Single-wall gauge
rules.plain: A {v} single wall is outside 0.5-0.8 mm
rules.note: Dent resistance and draw stages; no manufacturer publishes gauges.

rules.name: Outer wall gauge
rules.plain: A {v} outer wall is outside 0.3-0.8 mm
rules.note: Buckling, drop dents and polishing allowance; 0.3 mm sourced from Tiger.

rules.name: Inner wall gauge
rules.plain: A {v} inner wall is outside 0.08-0.5 mm
rules.note: 0.3-0.5 mm for bulged liners; Tiger spins liners down to 0.08 mm.

rules.name: Stability on a 10° incline
rules.plain: It tips at {v}, under the 10° incline test
rules.note: EN 12546-1 and factory QC; checked full, half full and empty, with the lid.

rules.name: Heat retention, EN 12546-1
rules.plain: Estimated {v} short of the EN 12546-1 6 h minimum for its capacity
rules.note: Minimums are sourced (60-80 C by capacity); the end temperature is our rough model, fitted to Tiger only. Checked only when the market is the EU.

rules.name: Mouth on a public lid family
rules.plain: The mouth is off the standard lid families, so it needs new lid molds
rules.note: Narrow 40-49 mm and wide 57-66 mm mouths reuse public lids; tumbler rims 75-105 mm (estimate). A new neck size forces new multi-part lid molds, the costliest tooling.

rules.name: Wall for a rolled thread
rules.plain: The neck wall is {v}, too thin to roll a thread; it needs a PP thread collar
rules.note: Rolled threads need about 0.4-0.5 mm of local wall.

rules.name: Height / diameter
rules.source: survey of double-wall bottles (n=20) and tumblers
rules.plain: H/D {v} with the cap on is outside what the market sells
rules.note: Market survey of double-wall bottles, median 3.26, measured with the cap on (so we add an assumed cap height). Tumblers: 1.95 sourced (Yeti 30 oz); widened to 2.7 for tall tumblers like the Stanley Quencher.

rules.name: Mouth / body
rules.plain: Mouth/body {v} is outside what the market sells

rules.name: Empty mass per ml
rules.plain: {v} of steel and lid per ml is outside the market's range

rules.name: Capacity
rules.source: survey of double-wall bottles (n=31) and tumblers (n=10)
rules.plain: {v} is outside the capacities on the market

rules.name: Fits a car cup holder
rules.plain: {v} wide in the bottom 75 mm, too wide for a cup holder
rules.note: Stanley Quencher's 75 mm base. Off unless switched on.
